senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (ऋ) देकृ (द्रेकते)
1 To sound.
2 To grow or increase.
3 To manifest joy or elevation by noise.

m. (-क्कः)
The regent of one-third of a planetary sign.

m. (-णः)
The regent of one-third of a planetary sign, the Decanus of European astrology, whence the word is probably derived.
